l01d: Everyone on your team has their own skills, in their own versions. None of them match.
l02: Meet Dalo. There's nothing new to learn. Just ask your agent.
l04: Your team picks the skills once, in Git. Everyone gets the same set, in Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
l05: Underneath the conversation sits a deterministic core.
l07: New skills wait for your approval.
l08: And Dalo only touches what it owns.
l09: Dalo. Manage your agent's setup. Just ask.
l03d: Daylo finds them, checks them, and shows you exactly what changed.
